picks.headline: Large NIH-supported study identifies key underlying pathways in endometriosis
picks.blurb: Researchers report genetic associations and mechanisms that help explain how this complex disorder develops.

picks.headline: RFK Jr. and MAHA must promote the MMR vaccine
picks.blurb: A podcast co-host's opinion column argues that Kennedy is positioned to reach vaccine-hesitant parents during the ongoing measles outbreak.

picks.headline: Why Africa needs more women surgeons
picks.blurb: Only about 10% of the continent's surgeons are women, even as the overall number of surgeons there has risen.

picks.headline: Aging drives distinct chromatin signatures of CD8 T cell dysfunction
picks.blurb: Mapping chromatin accessibility in young and aged mice, the study links older T cells' decline to lost gene regulation and a distinct regulatory subset.

picks.headline: Can AI help scientists identify promising drug candidates?
picks.blurb: A new benchmark tests how well AI models read molecular structures, weigh experimental evidence and choose compounds in early drug discovery.

picks.headline: Peptides go mainstream as Hims and Noom enter the market
picks.blurb: Two telehealth companies launched peptide programs this week after HHS eased compounding pharmacy access to drugs such as BPC-157.

picks.headline: Kennedy funds $47 million in 'Food is Medicine' pilot projects
picks.blurb: An HHS pilot gives 15 U.S. groups a chance to show that nutrition coaching and lifestyle programs merit Medicare coverage.

picks.headline: FDA rejects Capricor's Duchenne therapy, a decision long in coming
picks.blurb: The agency declined to approve the cell therapy deramiocel for Duchenne muscular dystrophy; STAT's columnist argues the data never supported it despite a public pressure campaign.

picks.headline: Celldex culls eczema study after Phase 2 failure
picks.blurb: The company is dropping its monoclonal antibody barzolvolimab as an eczema therapy after the drug failed a mid-stage trial.

picks.headline: Patients have little say in brain implant trials; Ian Burkhart wants to change that
picks.blurb: The founder of a coalition of brain-implant trial participants argues developers should give volunteers more agency in how studies are designed and run.

picks.headline: FDA will miss rare decision deadline for Savara candidate after three-month delay
picks.blurb: Savara's stock fell 18% after the announcement, while analysts still expect approval and point to possible capacity constraints at the agency.

picks.headline: Study raises doubts about combining vaccine, monoclonal antibody to protect against malaria
picks.blurb: Researchers found that a malaria-preventing monoclonal antibody interfered with a new vaccine's response when both were given to infants.
